purpose: Completed historical offline acceptance comparison; no live orders or profitability claim

approved_order_diagnostics.purpose: Retrospective fixed-price/48h-lifetime diagnosis only; no expiry changes or optimization
approved_order_diagnostics.note: Candle ranges cannot locate the exact intrahour first touch. Entries remain unfilled in original replay; post-expiry touches do not authorize or imply a trade.

limitations: Historical engineering diagnostics only; no current opportunities or release authorization
Hourly fills/management instead of production 3m; conservative OHLC ordering and next-hour entry eligibility
Default scans hourly instead of runtime default 60s; finer scans cannot reconstruct intrahour fills or exposure changes
Synthetic quantity/tick limits, assumed 0.01% spread, zero funding for sizing; realized funding unknown
No AI, macro gate or live account; independent symbol books starting flat at 10000
Risk circuit historical path not replayed; closed PnL before funding used for sizing; no portfolio-return inference
Fixed full available contiguous history origin; production persisted history may differ
Only the contiguous segment containing the requested end is replayed; no filling or bridging source gaps
controls: All arms use identical full available contiguous source origins per symbol and the same replay, hourly cadence, risk thresholds/costs, and simulation. Baseline v1.1 uses isolated importlib module and private assess clone with VERSION alone changed; no shared risk-module mutation. This does not isolate runner changes relative to old 500D/500x4H research reports.
incomplete_runs_excluded: The 365D preflight stopped at its 230s budget and is not a complete annual result. Partial 75s diagnostic attempts and the failed macOS fork launch are excluded. Completed 90D runs supersede those diagnostics without overwriting them.
